Units Sold by Product

Pick a period (by month or by week) and a channel. The chart and the table below both follow those choices, and every year-over-year figure is compared with the same days one year earlier — a month still in progress is compared with the same dates last year, never with the whole month. One row per product: website and Amazon sales of the same item are combined, under its Product Catalog name. Amazon multipacks are counted as single packages (a pack of 3 counts as 3). Click any row for that product's history.

Volume by Product Type

Units compared across product types for the period, channel and brand selected above; click any type to break it down by size. Type comes from the product line (Herbal Coffee, Herbal Tea, Instant Coffee, …), not the packaging. Size comes from the Product Catalog, and sizes stay grouped by basis — an 11 oz × 3 multipack is never added to a bare 11 oz.

Size Mix

Units by product size for the period, channel, brand and category selected above, against the same days one year earlier. Size comes from the Product Catalog, not the SKU code. Each basis is its own table on purpose: the catalog declares every basis comparable with itself only. Shares are within a basis, never across.

Product History

Search any product for its full history — or click any row above. Shows website paid, subscription, free, wholesale and Amazon units, with revenue on a second axis.
